summary.intent: Execute phase 19.2 gap closure plans for IPFS upload performance optimization, addressing verification gaps around PERF-09 requirement registration and non-definitive post-optimization baselines.
summary.outcome: PERF-09 was registered in REQUIREMENTS.md, plan 19.2-04 was replanned to use a three-point local baseline comparison instead of staging, env was configured with real someguy delegated routing, and a todo was captured for mock-ipns-routing removal. Load tests were not yet run — blocked waiting for Docker stack redeployment.

repo: Load test bypass requires two separate secrets: LOAD_TEST_SECRET (for POST /auth/test-login) and THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET (sent as X-Throttle-Bypass header) — both must match values in apps/api/.env
vitest does not load dotenv automatically — load test secrets must be passed as inline shell env vars, not via .env files
DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL in apps/api/.env controls IPNS routing; was pointing to localhost:3001 (mock-ipns-routing), updated to http://192.168.133.114:8190 (someguy)
BypassableThrottlerGuard skips rate limiting via X-Throttle-Bypass header using timing-safe comparison; only active when NODE_ENV !== 'production'
The load test upload-throughput scenario uses LOAD_TEST_CLIENTS env var and collects p50/p95/p99/min/max/avg latencies plus throughput ops/s
Three git checkpoints identified for baseline comparison: parent of 4087fa2b6 (pre-optimization), 565dccd5d (SDK concurrent pins, flatfs), and HEAD (concurrent pins + pebbleds)

code.finding: DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL changed from http://localhost:3001 to http://192.168.133.114:8190 to use real someguy instead of mock-ipns-routing
Metrics harness collects per-operation p50/p95/p99/min/max/avg latencies and throughput ops/s
Upload throughput scenario runs N clients × 20 files each with file sizes 1KB-500KB
Client pool handles concurrent load test connections; LOAD_TEST_CLIENTS env var controls parallelism

workflow: Same-environment three-point baselines (no opts → SDK only → SDK+infra) are more analytically sound than cross-environment comparisons; eliminates confounding variables
Probing concurrency limits before recording baselines (Run 0) gives a principled client count for subsequent runs
When staging involves destructive operations (volume deletion), local dev comparison with matched conditions is a valid and safer alternative for performance validation

friction: Initial verification failure was partly caused by pre/post baselines captured in different environments (staging vs localhost) with different client counts — a methodology gap not caught during planning
vitest not loading dotenv meant secrets had to be passed inline rather than via .env; this was discovered mid-session
PERF-09 was referenced in both plans but was never formally registered in REQUIREMENTS.md — a traceability gap that caused verification to fail
open_items: Run 0 (concurrency limit probe) + Runs 1-3 (three-point baselines) not yet executed — blocked on Docker stack redeployment with flatfs
